name: NAME-ADOPT-1-the-flow-never-adopts
note: BUG 1 VERBATIM. `register` answers the handle and a recovery code, not a session, so the store keeps the guest's name - and the top-right button reads the store. Mac: "The top right corner button doesnt update with name".

name: NAME-ADOPT-2-the-minter-throws-the-answer-away
note: The state the arc shipped in: the token kept, and `name`, `kind`, `title` and `glyphs` dropped on the floor beside it.

name: NAME-ADOPT-3-the-host-never-hears
old: try { onIssued?.(who); } catch { /* the token still goes */ }
note: The store would be right and the LIVE sessions would not - the roster keeps the character's name until the page reloads.

name: NAME-ADOPT-4-a-broken-host-costs-the-token
old: try { onIssued?.(who); } catch { /* the token still goes */ }
note: A display seam that throws would take the hello's word with it - and since ACC1g a tokenless hello is REFUSED, so a bug in how a name is drawn becomes a player who cannot connect at all.

name: NAME-ADOPT-5-adopt-resurrects-a-session
old:
const was = storedSession(storage);
  if (!was) return false;
note: A mint answer landing after a sign-out would write a session back - a signed-out player signed back in by a network race, with no secret in the row.

name: NAME-ADOPT-6-adopt-writes-every-time
old: if (next.name === was.name && next.kind === was.kind) return false;   // nothing to write, and a write is a storage event every open tab hears
note: A mint happens on every connect and a store write is a `storage` event in every other open tab - the menu repaints for nothing, across the whole browser, every reconnect.

name: NAME-ADOPT-7-the-session-keeps-the-character
old: if (n !== this.name) { this.name = n; changed = true; }
note: BUG 2 VERBATIM. Mac: "Ingame your name shows for other people but you still see your character name in the chat menu".

name: NAME-ADOPT-8-my-own-badge-never-arrives
old: if (b.title !== (this.title ?? null)) { this.title = b.title; changed = true; }
note: The same bug on the badge, unreported because nobody held a title yet: ACC3c built my roster row from the session and nothing ever put a title on it. The first developer to equip one would have seen it on everybody's screen but their own.

name: NAME-ADOPT-9-my-own-badge-trusted-unchecked
new: const b = { title: title ?? null, glyphs: glyphs ?? [] };
note: A second spelling of the vocabulary check, and a missing one: a badge this build has never heard of would be painted beside my own name while being refused beside everybody else's.

name: NAME-ADOPT-10-the-host-starts-from-the-character
note: The line under the comment that said it "is carried no further". It was: into the session's own name, which the roster draws my row from. Without the stored name first, the roster is wrong until the first mint answers.

name: NAME-ADOPT-11-only-the-presence-session-hears
note: The roster draws my row from the CHAT link its tab holds, not from the presence session - so correcting only `online` fixes nothing Mac could see.
